suggestions.title: Do These With a Clinician: a pointer to Imagery Rescripting

inserts.text: One bigger container is a clinical therapy called [Imagery Rescripting](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/201523223/imagery-rescripting), which I go into in my somatic guide. It works a lot like the way I [re-do trauma memories](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/i/189761959/re-do-trauma-memories) in my inner child reparenting guide, where you imagine a painful memory going differently. In Imagery Rescripting, though, the therapist is in the scene with you, stepping in as the ideal adult who protects and nurtures your inner child until, over the sessions, you learn to be that adult yourself.

suggestions.what: A paragraph of its own at the end of the section, after "high-risk trauma work needs a bigger container than that": one such container, Imagery Rescripting, linked to its section in your somatic guide; how it is like the way you re-do trauma memories in your inner child guide (linked), and how it differs, the therapist in the scene as the ideal adult until you can be that adult yourself. It carries the somatic guide's "Imagery Rescripting" and the inner child guide's pointer to it (both live since 27 November).
